tagline: Film looks and editor's-choice color grades
summary: One-click color looks, including film emulations of classic stocks and hand-made grades. Each look has an intensity slider so you can make it as subtle as you like.
useCases: Give a whole video a consistent look quickly
Start from a grade and fine-tune it
howTo: Select a clip and open the Color workspace
Click a look to preview it
Use the intensity slider to blend it in
